description: Import a recipe or protocol from a URL or service into a program. source: spoonacular, themealdb (recipes); protocolsio, opentrons, benchling (lab); cooklang (.cook URL). action: search (no login), import (query = URL or id), random. import, random and benchling need the account. `enrich: true` splits an import into parallel tracks. Returns the program.

enrich.description: With action='import': split the import into parallel tracks with cross-track triggers. One model call, capped per day.

query.description: Keywords (search), or the URL or id (import).

text.description: Pasted source (an Opentrons .py) instead of a URL.

token.description: Access token from the login tool. Omit when the account is connected.

name: import_from_source
title: Import from an external source
